description: KinSeal Studio WinUSB bridge and HMI uploader for Windows 11 ARM, UTM on Mac, and Apple Silicon macOS. Tested with AMZ043W01; native macOS uploads confirmed.
macos_native_hardware_test: User-confirmed successful native AMZ043W01 upload with sudo and --detach-kernel-driver.
license_scope: Independently written components only; libusb, Go, compiler runtimes and manufacturer software retain separate rights/licenses.
rootless_hid_status: Investigated with native IOKit and HIDAPI; model writes succeeded but no model replies received; not a usable rootless transport.
